hint: Read the element into a variable, change that, and store it back: `mut e: T = x[i]; e.field = v; x[i] = e;`. `x[i]` returns the element by value, so a write would change only a copy. Writing through a pointer or reference element, or into a nested list (`grid[i][j] = v`), is fine.
